color.$description: Sunrise's orb glows in its area's color. Dashboard's Earth Moss is the default; an area page sets these to its own color family.

light.$description: The brightest light inside the orb.

glow.$description: The glow nearest the orb, and its farthest bloom.

shade.$description: The deepest color, at the top of the glass.

plain.$description: The light on a plain page (the theme's own page color behind it). Pure white: a plain page has no color to blend with.

plain-far.$description: Where the light on a plain page fades out, it warms to this. Transparent: Sunrise's light stays white all the way out.
